verdict.rationale: Tavily has a dedicated rate-limits page with per-environment RPM caps (Development 100, Production 1,000) and documents 429 responses with a retry-after header. Its pricing page shows a free 1,000 credits/month tier with no credit card and a pay-as-you-go option at $0.008/credit, which implies a self-serve path to more usage. A usage endpoint also lets developers track consumption. Missing for 10: explicit concurrency caps (only requests per minute are documented), a documented self-serve flow for upgrading limits (e.g., how a key moves from Development to Production limits), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
